flags.observation: Card is sung as "The Guarantee"; the printed card name is cut, so the name-first rule is broken.
"The Gatekeeper" and beat 20 "Gatekeeper" sound identical once brackets drop; the two cards become indistinguishable by ear.
"helping behavior repeats even when it fails" recites the power almost word for word, reading like a rule.
"sell a false solution confidently" recites the power; with the opener the line runs 127 characters, past one breath.
"After the fall, a vendor appears" is a sequence step, an and-then link with no cause or twist.
"After closing" repeats the After-family opener only three beats after beat 32, under the ten-line distance.
"divides: Future Self: The One Who Left" stacks two colons in one breath; 119 characters overall.
"work, love, sanity, chaos, balanced" is a bare noun list; hard to phrase as one spoken thought.
"Wait… What?, meaning" collides ellipsis, question mark and comma; the read stumbles at the card name.
Callback openers mostly name only the directly preceding card; beat 37 is the only reach back to an earlier card.
"Admission includes:" presents the whistle as an inventory item, a prop without want, wound or grudge.
"They kept the fee" leans cynical about paid help; aimed at providers, not seekers, yet it cools the warm close.
